summary: Verified live Expo web preview on mobile viewport plus public API smoke coverage. Registration is blank, development OTP verification works, authenticated home loads, assessment validation works, Pulse 60 saves/upserts today, empty care/community states are honest, and logout restores registration.

ui_bugs.issue: Supervisor Expo logs and the post-logout browser state show repeated 'Unexpected text node:  . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' warnings. No flow was blocked, but this is a React Native rendering defect.

react_native_issues.issue: Interactive controls do not expose testID/testID-backed data-testid attributes, making robust acceptance automation and regression targeting difficult.

action_items: Find and remove the whitespace/raw text child producing the React Native web Unexpected text node warning.
Add testID to navigation, auth fields/buttons, assessment controls, Pulse 60 controls, care, consent, and logout controls.

Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract; src/api.ts currently reads app config backendUrl or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while frontend/.env has no EXPO_BACKEND_URL key.
critical_code_review_comments: The app currently has no testID attributes despite the acceptance requirement for reliable mobile UI automation.
src/api.ts does not directly consume EXPO_BACKEND_URL; the current preview works through EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, but this is a deployment/configuration contract risk.

Care booking catches no request error in DoctorCard, so a failed appointment API call can silently return to the idle button without an error message; this path was not reachable because the directory was empty.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed flows; runtime warning observed

seed_data_creation: Created one ephemeral UI registration account; no seed records were added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live UI flow completed on 375x667. Registration account was qa_ui_b7afd3e3e0@example.com and was logged out; no credentials need reuse. Empty doctors and community states were verified.
rca_of_issue: The Unexpected text node warning is emitted by Expo web during/after the authenticated flow and is visible in /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log. Source review found JSX whitespace around inline children (especially compact one-line components); isolate the offending View child and wrap/remove raw whitespace, then retest web runtime logs.
